title: Dyadic per-node failure parameter
statement: For natural numbers $k$ and $m$, the dyadic per-node failure parameter is the per-call failure allocation for a size-$k$ junta tree when the overall dyadic failure parameter is $2^{-(m+1)}$.
hypotheses_covered: The junta size parameter $k$ is a natural number
The confidence bit count $m$ is a natural number
caveat: The supplied definitions do not give the formula for the per-call failure allocation.
